instruction: Cinematic still, wide low-angle shot. In a dimly lit hall with wooden floors, three dancers perform floor choreography. In the center foreground, the young man in the white t-shirt and black harness (R3) leans back, supporting himself on his right hand with his left leg extended. On the left, the blonde man in the black leather jacket (R1) leans back on the floor. On the far right, the man in the black mesh top (R2) is partially visible lying down. Moody red and blue lighting illuminates the dramatic poses.
